playground.skillCreateUploadHint: Upload a SKILL.md whose YAML has required keys: name (kebab-case identifier) and description. Optional: argument-hint, allowed-tools, user-invocable, and metadata (display_name, trigger_hints, reminder_delay, order_sheet_id, required_tools, steps, …).

playground.skillFieldIdleReminderHint: Automatically nudge the user if they don't respond within the delay.
playground.skillScheduleHint: When enabled, the backend emits a test message to the Playground on a cron schedule (socket push). Sub-minute intervals are for development only. If SKILL_SCHEDULE_TEST_INTERVAL_MS is set on the server, DB cron is ignored for that process.
playground.skillReferencesHint: Optional .md / .txt files under references/ are loaded on demand (LOAD_REFERENCE or LOAD_REFERENCE:filename). Keep SKILL.md for the workflow; use these for long notes.
playground.skillReferencesEmpty: No reference files yet. Upload .md or .txt files.
playground.skillReferenceSelectFile: Select a file above to edit.
playground.skillReferencePlaceholder: Paste reference documentation here (loaded on-demand by the AI when needed)...
playground.skillScriptsEmpty: No scripts yet. Scripts run as subprocesses — code is never sent to the LLM.
playground.skillDeleteConfirm: Delete this skill? This cannot be undone.
playground.skillFrontmatterHelp: Edit the YAML block at the top of SKILL.md (do not type the --- lines; they are added automatically). Standard fields: name (kebab-case id), description, optional argument-hint / allowed-tools. Put Foodflow-specific config under metadata: display_name, trigger_hints (list), reminder_delay, max_reminders, schedule_*, order_sheet_id, sheet_fields, required_tools, and steps (workflow). Saving writes SKILL.md and syncs parsed fields into the database when possible.
playground.skillAssetsHint: Files are stored under this skill’s assets/ folder (e.g. Word templates for office_files). In SKILL.md use paths like assets/filename.docx when the skill runs inside execute_skill.
playground.skillAssetsEmpty: No asset files yet. Upload templates or documents the skill should read from disk.
